en.quranPronunciation.title: Check pronunciation
en.quranPronunciation.intro: Read the ayah on screen aloud, then tap Done. Each word comes back as Clear, Listen again or Not sure. Everything stays on your device.
en.quranPronunciation.introSkipped: Read the ayah on screen aloud, then tap Done. Words that seem skipped or unclear are marked so you can listen to them again. Everything stays on your device.
en.quranPronunciation.listening: Listening… read at your own pace, then tap Done.
en.quranPronunciation.unavailable: Pronunciation checks aren't available on this device.
en.quranPronunciation.micDenied: The microphone is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings to check your reading.
en.quranPronunciation.result.headClear: Nothing to listen to again in this ayah
en.quranPronunciation.result.listenHint: These words didn't come through clearly. Tap one to hear the reciter, then read the ayah again.
en.quranPronunciation.result.skippedHint: These words seemed skipped or unclear. Tap one to hear the reciter, then read the ayah again.
en.quranPronunciation.result.notSureNote: Words marked Not sure couldn't be judged either way — that's not a problem.
en.quranPronunciation.noFit.too-short: That was too short to follow. Read the whole ayah, then tap Done.
en.quranPronunciation.noFit.different-passa: Couldn't follow this ayah. Make sure it's the ayah on screen and try again.
en.quranPronunciation.noFit.too-many-flags: Couldn't follow this ayah clearly. Try again somewhere quieter, a little closer to the phone.
en.quranPronunciation.noFit.no-text: This ayah can't be checked with the installed listener yet.
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.cta: Read one ayah to calibrate for your voice
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.intro: Calibrating: read this ayah as you normally would, then tap Done. This only adjusts how cautious the check is on this device.
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.saved: Calibrated for this device. Your next checks will use it.
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.not-enough: That wasn't enough to calibrate. Try a slightly longer ayah.
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.no-fit: Couldn't follow that reading, so nothing was saved. Try again.
en.quranPronunciation.calibrate.error: Calibration didn't finish. Nothing was saved.
en.quranPronunciation.model.title: Download the listener
en.quranPronunciation.model.body: Pronunciation checks use an on-device listener (about {{size}} MB, shared with Qur'an practice and hands-free tasbeeh). Wi-Fi recommended.
en.quranPronunciation.model.otherEngine: Pronunciation checks need the FastConformer listener. Downloading it replaces your current practice listener; practice keeps working with it.
en.quranPronunciation.copy.tartil: Take your time — recite in measured tartil.
en.quranPronunciation.copy.effort: Reading with effort is rewarded too: the one who finds the Qur'an hard and keeps going has a double reward.
en.quranPronunciation.copy.teacher: This is a practice aid, not a judgement of your recitation. Check your recitation with a qualified teacher.
en.quranPronunciation.summary.title: Your reading
en.quranPronunciation.summary.nothingFlagge: No words to listen to again this time.
en.quranPronunciation.summary.feedsCoaching: These words will be used as examples in your tajweed coaching. You can turn this off in Settings › Qur'an › Practice.
en.quranPronunciation.summary.feedOff: Adding these words to tajweed coaching is off in Settings › Qur'an › Practice.
en.quranPronunciation.settings.feedCoaching: Use checked words in tajweed coaching
Words a pronunciation check marks Listen again become example words in your coaching plan.
en.quranPronunciation.settings.keywords: pronunciation, recitation, check, listen again, tajweed, coaching, calibrate, voice
en.quranPronunciation.settings.calibrationS: Forget the voice calibration saved on this device.
en.quranPronunciation.settings.calibrationR: Reset the pronunciation calibration on this device?
